ModMetaData.name: Add windows to your house！
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Add windows to your house！This mod adds half walls and the sliding windows that go on them.
- Half walls: a waist-high wall nothing crosses. Like a wall it closes a room, but it holds up no roof - and the day comes in over its top. - Windows: fit one on top of a half wall (the button on the wall, or the Structure menu) and a colonist builds it. One half wall takes one window. Once a window is in, that half wall counts as a real wall: it closes a room and holds a roof. - Two solid boards in a frame, no glass. Open and close a window by hand: a colonist slides the boards apart or shut; a half-open window carries on from where it stopped. - Light: shut, the window blocks light like a wall; open, it lets the day in. How bright it gets and how far it reaches follow how far the boards are apart, and a lamp's light passes through an open window too. The light only goes to the darker side - a window never glows back into the sunlight it faces. - A window set across the wall (sideways) is always open to the light, always ventilates at a fully open vent's rate, and always leaks vacuum like a fully open window: its boards slide along the wall and cover nothing. Shots go through it too, but only as a slot (below). - Shooting: any crack lets a shot through. From 50% to 99% open - and always for a sideways window - the opening is a slot: shots go, but part of them are stopped by the window itself. Fully open (100%) is a clean shot. Below half open it is a crack: nine in ten shots are stopped by the window. Only a window shut tight is a wall - and even then the window can be attacked and shot apart like any building. It works both ways: colonists fire out, enemies fire in, and grenades, explosions and beam weapons pass too. Whoever stands beside the window is covered by the half wall like behind a barricade, not like a full wall. A shot a window stops lands on the window and damages it - a window shot apart leaves the bare half wall; a fully open window is never hit by bullets. - Ventilation: shut, the window seals the room like a brick wall; open, heat passes through in proportion to how far the boards have moved, up to a vent's rate when it is fully open - with the next room and with the outdoors alike. On an orbital map an open window also lets the vacuum in. A window set across the wall always ventilates and always leaks vacuum, whatever its boards are doing. - HP, build time, opening speed, flammability and beauty match a door of the same material; a wooden window costs 10 wood, two fifths of a wooden door. Deconstruct the window and half of that comes back; take the wall down with the window still in it and the glazing is broken out instead, returning a quarter.
REQUIRES, in this order: Harmony, IsoRim Waylith, and IsoRim ProjectZ (the base mod this is built on - install it in Mods/ as well, from the same author). RimWorld 1.7. Works with IsoRim ProjectZ as published: nothing in the base mod has to be changed or updated for this addon.
给房子开一扇窗！本 mod 添加半墙和装在半墙上的推拉窗。
- 半墙：齐腰高、过不去的墙。像墙一样能围出房间，但不撑屋顶 —— 日光从墙头上越过。 - 窗户：在半墙上装窗（半墙上的按钮，或建造菜单），小人建造；一堵半墙只装一扇窗。装上窗之后，那格半墙就算真正的墙： 能围出房间、能撑屋顶。 - 两扇实心木板加边框，没有玻璃。窗要手动开合：小人把木板推开或拉回；关到一半被打断，下次接着来。 - 透光：关着时像墙一样挡光；开着时把日光放进屋里，亮度和照得多远都跟着木板推开的程度走，开着的窗也放灯光过去。 光只往暗的那一侧透，不会朝对着的太阳那一面发光。 - 侧着放（横跨墙）的窗永远透光、永远按全开通风孔的速率通风、永远像全开的窗一样漏真空 —— 它的木板是沿墙滑的， 挡不住开口；它也能被射击穿过，但只算一个射孔（见下）。 - 隔窗射击：开度一半以上的窗可以射击、可以看穿，侧向窗任何时候都可以；全开（100%）没有惩罚， 50%–99%（以及侧向窗）只算一个射孔 —— 能打但命中打折；开度低于 50% 就是一条缝，还能打，但九成打在窗上。 只有完全关死才等于墙——而且关死的窗本身仍然可以被打、被打烂。双向生效：屋里能打出去、 外面能打进来，手雷、爆炸、射线武器也穿得过去。站在窗旁的人仍以半墙当掩体（按路障算，不是整墙）。 被半开的窗（或任何侧向窗）挡下的子弹会打在窗上、把窗打坏 —— 窗被打烂后只剩半墙；全开的窗不会被枪弹打到。 - 通风：关着时像砖墙一样密封；开着时按木板推开的程度通风，全开时约等于一个通风孔 —— 房间之间、房间与室外之间都算。 在轨道环境下开窗还会放真空进来。侧向窗无论开关，永远按全开通风孔的速率通风、永远漏真空。 - 血量、建造时间、开关速度、易燃性、美观都和同材料的门一致；木窗 10 木头，是同材料门成本的五分之二。 拆窗本身返还一半；连墙一起拆则是把窗砸下来，返还四分之一。
**必须**按顺序装：Harmony、IsoRim Waylith，以及 **IsoRim ProjectZ**（本 mod 依赖的基座，需要另外放进 Mods 文件夹）。 RimWorld 1.7。
